name: Vicious Mockery
summary: A cantrip of enchanted insults that deals Psychic damage and gives the target Disadvantage on its next attack.

stats.effect: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at one creature you can see or hear within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d6 Psychic damage and have {ref:glossary/disadvantage} on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
stats.cantripUpgrade: The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).
